notes.title: Demo v0.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p][url="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1blK7kXP_4mli9tVKglHLeWHLg3xrFr1a2O5wTtXob4g/edit?usp=sharing" style="button"]You can view the patch notes for all previous versions here![/url][/p][h1]Version 0.3.0[/h1][h2]New Additions[/h2][list][*][p][i]Added a new Solo mode called “Scarecrow Shakedown”, where you deal as much damage to a dummy as you can in a 15-second time limit while the team’s tag meter constantly refills. See if you can set any high scores![/i][/p][/*][*][p]Added Badges - modifiers that can change character stats. Head into the Collections menu to create some Badge sets, and mess around with them in offline versus matches![/p][/*][*][p][i]All fighters now have voice lines & facial expressions.[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Fighters now have motion trails on a few attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fighters now glow while charging Neutral Attack, and flash just before their Supercharges activate. A sound effect also plays to indicate attack charging.[/p][/*][*][p]Alice also glows while charging her Mad Tea Set.[/p][/*][*][p]A new cameo character was added to the background of the Dreamscraper Tower stage to watch your matches. She wants to see… wants to see you fighting…[/p][/*][*][p][i]Bird on a Gilded Road (Dorothy’s Theme) [/i]now available as a music track for matches.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a combo counter display.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where “Auto Music” wouldn’t always play the themes of characters in the match.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Mechanics/Balance Changes[/h2][h3]All Fighters[/h3][list][*][p]By releasing the input during your jumpsquat, you can perform a Short Hop, jumping roughly half the height of your normal jump. Certain characters get more tech out of this than others.[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you run, you’ll have a brief initial dash speed. This should give players access to better grounded burst movement.[/p][/*][*][p]If you have any full bars of tag meter, pressing Quarter Circle Forward (Down, Down-Forward, Forward) + Attack or Quarter Circle Backward (Down, Down-Back, Back) + Attack will expend a bar of tag meter and immediately perform a Supercharge. This gives you faster access to Supercharge than holding the Attack button, but of course spending your tag meter will lose you access to tag combos & defensive tags temporarily.[/p][list][*][p]If both tag partners’ meters are full, QCF will expend the first partner’s tag meter, while QCB will expend the second partner’s tag meter.[/p][/*][*][p]Dorothy will expend both bars of tag meter when activating her Supercharge in this way.[/p][/*][*][p]Notably, this method for activating Supercharge works even if your teammates are knocked out, providing another reason to build up tag meter even if you only have one fighter remaining.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Alice[/h3][p]Since all the clever stuff to work around Alice’s Croquet Hoop infinite combo didn’t work, it’s just been directly coded out. To compensate, the multi-hit damage of the attack has been restored.[/p][list][*][p][b][i]When three Air Attacks are used without landing, the fourth Air Attack will automatically cancel into the Corner Cancel landing hit.[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Air Attack Damage (Hits 1, 2, 3): [/b]300 → 600[/p][list][*][p][b]Total Damage:[/b] 2000 → 2900[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Creature[/h3][h3]Dorothy[/h3][p]Similar to Alice, Dorothy also had an infinite cancelling the first hit of Heel Click into itself (though not as many players noticed it). It has also been directly coded out.[/p][list][*][p][b][i]When four Air Attacks are used without landing, the fifth Air Attack will have no hitbox for the first hit (forcing you to use the second hit).[/i][/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]Gatsby[/h3][h3]Wendy[/h3][p]While proper spacing is one of the hallmarks of Wendy’s gameplay, her Playing House was a bit too precise to hit, often overshooting opponents even when it seems like you’ve correctly comboed into it (e.g. using Shadow Catch). By letting players drop early, Wendy’s combos should work at more ranges.[/p][list][*][p][b]During Crouch Attack (frames 20-35), press Attack again to drop early.[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]Willie[/h3][p]Willie also had a near-infinite that players complained about (technically there was 1 frame to block, but of course that’s a hard window to hit if you’re being comboed), thanks to his Xylodontist pulling opponents in at low charge. The properties of Xylodontist have been changed so it’s still useful as a combo tool into Steam Toot, but doesn’t work as an infinite anymore.[/p][list][*][p][b][i]Neutral Attack now pushes opponents back at all charge levels (though higher charge levels still push further). This means even uncharged Neutral Attack will send the opponent out of range after a few hits.[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Neutral Attack Recovery Frames (low charge): [/b]29 → 15[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Updated [i]Marches Monstres (Creature's Theme) [/i]to better fit the instrumentals and mixing of the rest of the game’s OST.[/p][/*][*][p]In Training (Practice) Mode: by pressing inputs on a second controller on the character select screen, you will be able to control player 2 during the match.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo v0.2.6 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h1]Version 0.2.6[/h1][h2]New Additions[/h2][list][*][p][i]Mickie die Mauser (Willie's Theme) now available as a music track for matches.[/i][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where if you tried to leave an online lobby at the same time as your friend, you could be stuck in the “are you sure” screen forever.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where remapped controls were not properly assigned in pause menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved efficiency of particle systems (tagging, Dorothy’s teleports, Creature’s paralysis, Gatsby’s drunk effect, etc) to hopefully fix issues of lag on lower-end machines.[/p][/*][*][p]The match timer no longer counts down during the intros/after the match ends.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Mechanics/Balance Changes[/h2][h3]All Fighters[/h3][list][*][p]By pressing Back + Attack in the air, you will turn around to perform your aerial attack. This should make cross-ups much more viable while also letting you vary your movement in other situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Press a direction while tagging to choose where the teammate will appear. This also applies after KO. This should unlock more options to use tags defensively, where before there were too many combos that locked the opponent in whether or not they tagged.[/p][/*][*][p]Tag cooldown 4 seconds → 0.5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Press Down in the air to perform Guardfall, a new movement option. Guardfall is an invincible fast-fall type move. Useful for getting out of a sticky situation when you don’t have tags available (e.g., accidentally Airdashing into someone’s charged attack), and it can cover descents for characters like Willie who lack a divekick-type move.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Alice[/h3][p]Alice’s Croquet Hoop is an incredibly oppressive tool in her kit, especially when combo’d with other teammates. By reducing the damage of the multihit spin, Alice’s loops should give the opponent more time to charge their tag meter. Combined with buffing the landing hit of Croquet Hoop, the corner hit of Croquet Hoop, and Off With Your Head, this should encourage Alice players to actually finish opponents with her finishers.[/p][list][*][p][b][i]Air Attack Damage (Hits 1, 2, 3):[/i][/b][i] 500 → 300[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Air Attack Damage (Hit 4):[/b] 500 → 1100[/p][list][*][p][b]Total Damage:[/b] 2000 → 2000[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Air Attack Damage Corner Cancel:[/b] 700 → 1300[/p][/*][*][p][b]Forward Attack (Throw) Damage Hit 4:[/b] 2000 → 2500[/p][list][*][p][b]Total Damage:[/b] 3200 → 3700[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b][i]Forward Attack (Throw) Total Frames:[/i][/b][i] 231 → 240[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]Creature[/h3][p]Creature can deal a lot of damage very quickly, and that’s a good thing. However, previously it didn’t take much effort to deal that burst damage, which was a problem. The high damage of his Crouch Attack combined with the ability to cross the stage quickly with Airdash before the paralysis wore off made it incredibly easy to TOD his opponent with whatever follow-up the player chose.[/p][p]Lowering Creature’s Airdash speed & decreasing the strength of Crouch Attack should incentivize players committing to a tag to complete his paralysis combos. Additionally, the strength of Air Attack was greatly reduced - it should still be worth the risk to fish for it, but it’s not sitting on par with some Supercharges anymore.[/p][list][*][p][b][i]Air Attack Damage:[/i][/b][i] 5000 → 3800[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Crouch Attack Damage (Hit 3):[/i][/b][i] 1500 → 1000[/i][/p][list][*][p][b][i]Total Damage:[/i][/b][i] 3000 → 2500[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b][i]Airdash Forward Speed:[/i][/b][i] 3500 → 2800[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Max HP:[/i][/b][i] 12500 → 13000[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]Wendy[/h3][p]It was definitely funny to watch Wendy get one-tapped by most charged moves (and Creature’s Air Attack), but while she’s always had the mobility to play around these strong attacks, the damage of her juggle combos wasn’t worth the risk of a single slip-up costing a third of your team. The increased HP should give players a bit more wiggle room before going down.[/p][list][*][p][b]Max HP:[/b] 5000 → 7500[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other Changes[/h2][list][*][p]CPU opponents are more aggressive. Comes at the cost of some strategy, but should hopefully be more entertaining to fight & watch.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the volume of some of Alice’s voice lines.[/p][/*][/list]
